# grepr_otlp_integration (Resource)

Manages an OTLP integration, used by pipelines to send logs and traces to an OTLP/HTTP endpoint. Secrets are written through dedicated endpoints after the integration is saved. They are sensitive but stored in Terraform state. They are write-only: the API never returns them, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Removing a secret from the configuration stops managing it without deleting it remotely. If a secret is rejected while the integration is being created, Terraform marks the integration tainted; run `terraform untaint` and apply again to retry the secret without replacing the integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "otlp_auth_header" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "grepr_otlp_integration" "main" {
  name     = "production_otlp"
  endpoint = "https://otlp.example.com"
  headers  = [{ name = "X-Team", value = "platform" }]

  secret_headers = {
    Authorization = var.otlp_auth_header
  }
}

output "otlp_ingestion_token" {
  value     = grepr_otlp_integration.main.ingestion_token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Base OTLP/HTTP URL. Logs and traces go to `/v1/logs` and `/v1/traces` under it unless overridden.
- `name` (String) Integration name.

### Optional

- `attribute_headers` (Attributes List) Headers whose values come from each event's attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_headers))
- `headers` (Attributes List) Non-secret HTTP headers sent with every request. A name may repeat to send several values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--headers))
- `logs_endpoint` (String) Full URL for logs, overriding the one derived from `endpoint`.
- `output_encoding` (String) Request encoding, `proto` or `json` in lowercase. The server defaults it to `proto`. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current value.
- `secret_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret HTTP headers by exact name, such as `Authorization`. Removing a header from this map deletes it remotely; removing the whole attribute stops managing the headers without deleting them. Headers this resource never managed are left alone.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) Team IDs with access. Omit to keep the current teams; an empty set clears them.
- `traces_endpoint` (String) Full URL for traces, overriding the one derived from `endpoint`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `ingestion_token` (String, Sensitive) Token generated at creation that senders present to Grepr. Stored in state. After an import it is read once from an endpoint that requires edit access and is audit-logged.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization owning the integration.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Integration version used for optimistic locking.

<a id="nestedatt--attribute_headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attribute_headers`

Required:

- `attribute_path` (List of String) Attribute path segments, one per nesting level.
- `header_name` (String) Header to send.


<a id="nestedatt--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `headers`

Required:

- `name` (String) Header name.
- `value` (String) Header value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import grepr_otlp_integration.main INTEGRATION_ID
```
